prompt:
CAMERA: 35mm cinema lens, framed from BEHIND the person at shoulder height, locked-off and completely static for the whole shot. The camera never moves, never pans, never pushes in, never pulls back, never shows itself.
LOOK: match the reference frame's grade EXACTLY: dim night interior, heavily desaturated near-monochrome, deep grey shadows, no daylight, no bright walls, real film grain. The ONLY colored element in the entire video is one tiny highlighter-yellow point at the fingertip.
STYLE: cinematic brand film, slow, held, precise. No glow, no neon, no lens flare, no light particles: every dot is a matte physical grain, like a halftone made of real grains.
CHARACTER: one person seen ONLY from behind, face NEVER visible, the head never turns, no profile, no second person. Plain dark sweater, dark short hair. The right arm stays raised and perfectly still while the body dissolves. The person never walks and never moves away from the camera.
SETTING: continue the exact office in the reference frame at blue hour: sheets of paper frozen in mid-air, desks and monitors, the ceiling and far walls already broken into a fine lattice of matte grey dots.
CONSTRAINT: absolutely no letters, no words, no numbers, no signage, no handwriting, no typing of text. Keep text-bearing objects out of frame: no printed documents with visible type, no labels, no posters, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles. Any screen, paper or panel shows ONLY abstract grey bars, blocks, ticks and blank cells. Nothing is ever written or spelled. No colored element besides the single yellow point.
SCENES:
1. (~2s, static, framed from behind exactly as the reference) Nothing else moves. The papers stay frozen in mid-air. The body begins to break apart at the feet into small matte grey grains.
2. (~2s, same static frame) The dissolve rises from feet to shoulders. The freed grains flow into three thin converging pencil-like lines that leave through the upper right of the frame, the single tiny yellow point leading at the very front of the stream.
3. (~2s, same static frame) The last thing left is the raised right hand, which also loosens into grains and follows the three lines out of frame. The frozen office remains, still and lattice-grey. Hold.
